text:
tess: quick note from the SDK sample run: when running the Kotlin Java sample against emulator Android 14, OkHttp follows a 307 redirect and the Authorization header disappears on the redirected request. Works on Pixel (Android 12).
omar: that sounds bad for onboarding. is this reproducer using MockWebServer?
tess: yes, minimal: MockWebServer enqueues 307 + Location: /next then 200. Client built with addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor). followRedirects(true) -> header gone. followRedirects(false) -> header preserved.
li: can you paste the interceptor?
tess: small auth interceptor we ship in the samples:
```kotlin
class AuthInterceptor(val provider: TokenProvider) : Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val token = provider.get() ?: ""
    val r = chain.request().newBuilder()
      .addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
      .build()
    return chain.proceed(r)
  }
}
```
rafa: try replacing addHeader with .header("Authorization", ...) to avoid header duplication/merge issues across redirects.
tess: tried that 1 It fixed the small repro on the emulator. Also tried addNetworkInterceptor which preserved the header but regressed our Authenticator refresh because Authenticator expects app-interceptor context.
mina: can we document this in the sample README with two recommended workarounds: 1) use .header(...) in your interceptor, 2) use followRedirects(false) and follow Location manually while reattaching headers?
omar: yes and add a CI test using emulator-14 in the sample matrix so we don't regress.
dev-bot: INF-4501 created: "Auth header lost on 3xx redirect when using app interceptor on Android 14 emulator". Linked: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-samples/issue/INF-4501 and attached minimal repro.
li: short-term: update sample README and add MockWebServer test asserting Authorization present after redirect. Long-term: add a troubleshooting section to SDK auth docs explaining app vs network interceptors, Authenticator interplay, and redirect semantics.
tess: i'll open the PR with the test + README note. ping me if you want to test on physical devices. :thumbsup:
rafa: also note in the SDK changelog (beta notes) that Retrofit3 samples may require explicit header replacement for some Android 14 emulators.
mina: thanks all 1 small follow-up: can someone file a support ticket template snippet we can paste into customer triage when they hit this? saves time.
omar: i'll draft it in INF-4501.
tess: cheers, will share repro script and steps in the PR.
